summary: Diagnostic sweep (iteration_30). Challenges iteration_29 misses and reports NEW confirmed bugs. Backend not tested (Next.js app, no separate FastAPI logic). Frontend + code review focused on invoicing/B2G/settings/notifications and new HR (leave/bonuses/SEPA/severance/staff portal). External preview URL returns 200 on /login and /staff/<token>; server-action login race is flaky in the isolated Playwright container so parts were verified via SQLite + source review + one successful UI pass. Confirmed 3 HIGH bugs (SEPA Greek names → literal 'EMPLOYEE'; duplicate/overlapping leave requests accepted with no dedup; leaveAllowance() ignores endDate so employees leaving in Jan still receive full annual allowance) plus 4 MEDIUM/LOW. Challenged 3 iteration_29 findings: (a) B2G subscription key IS exposed conditionally for EPSILON — not a bug, (b) 'missing-field' seed literal is no longer present in the DB — resolved, (c) NotificationPrefsCard IS mounted at /account (not /settings) — iteration_29 wrongly labelled it HIGH globally missing.

ui_bugs.issue: The transliteration helper strips every Greek character (regex [^A-Za-z0-9 …]) then falls back to the literal 'EMPLOYEE' when the result is empty. Verified with node one-liner: latin('Παπαδόπουλος Νίκος') === 'EMPLOYEE'. Every row in the generated pain.001 XML for a Greek-named workforce will be <Cdtr><Nm>EMPLOYEE</Nm></Cdtr>, so the bank e-banking cannot distinguish which employee got which credit. This is exactly the 'SEPA Greek names not silently EMPLOYEE' concern in the request.

No overlap/duplicate check. Reproduction: POST identical leave for 2026-11-16→2026-11-17 twice from the staff portal → two 'Εκκρεμεί' rows persisted in leave_requests, both with days=2. On approval, decideLeaveRequest will also try to write two shift rows for the same date (one via update, one via insert) and submit TWO ERGANI LEAVE files for the same period. Needs: reject when pending/approved request overlaps existing (fromDate ≤ existing.toDate AND toDate ≥ existing.fromDate).

leaveDays() only looks at emp.hireDate and the calendar year — emp.endDate is never consulted. An employee whose endDate is in January still gets full 22 days × daily wage credited for the whole year (only capped at ½ monthly salary). For a mid-year leaver the allowance should be prorated to days actually worked in the year, or at least clipped by endDate. Christmas/Easter bonuses correctly clip on endDate via daysWithin(); leave allowance is inconsistent.

ui_bugs.component: Approve leave = automatic live ERGANI submit (leave.ts decideLeaveRequest)
ui_bugs.issue: On approve the code unconditionally calls submitErgani(db, org, 'LEAVE', …) using stored org creds. If the org is on mode=live (as demo org fa82eab8-… currently is, per iteration_29), a single accountant click sends a real WTOLeave declaration with no dry-run/confirmation. Recommend requiring an explicit checkbox 'Και υποβολή στην ΕΡΓΑΝΗ' with live-mode warning, or default to preparing an unsubmitted file when mode=live.

The 'Αποστολή email' dialog for invoices exposes only recipient + free-text message. There is no Subject input, so the accountant cannot customize the subject line; description text hints the customer receives a link/XML but does not preview it. Also no data-testid on any of the fields → automation gap.

Staff portal (staff-leave-from/to), invoice payment dialog (paidAt), recurring (nextRunAt) and quote dates all use the browser default <input type='date'> instead of the shadcn calendar/popover. In the staff portal test the raw browser picker renders 'MM/DD/YYYY' placeholders even for a Greek app (see screenshot /tmp/audit30_staff.png).

During Playwright sweep 429 responses were observed on rapid navigation; API_RATE_LIMIT=120 in /app/frontend/.env is per-IP without endpoint scoping, so a burst of dashboard widgets or a testing agent hits it. Same issue reported in iteration_29.

integration_issues.issue: Confirmed CORRECT (challenges iteration_29 defect claim): b2g-send-btn is disabled while validationErrors.length>0 in b2g-card.tsx:38-112, and invoice-actions.tsx only exposes 'Έκδοση/Επεξεργασία/Διαγραφή' on drafts. Cancel, credit, transmit-myDATA, email and PDF are gated by !isDraft. Draft B2G disabled is not a bug.

Confirmed EXISTS (challenges iteration_29 LOW claim): B2G_PROVIDERS[epsilon].fields includes b2gSubscriptionKey (providers.ts:60), b2g-settings-form.tsx:113-131 renders it conditionally when provider==='epsilon', with data-testid='b2g-field-b2gSubscriptionKey' and stored-key indicator. Not a missing UI.

Confirmed EXISTS at /account (challenges iteration_29 HIGH claim of globally missing): NotificationPrefsCard is mounted from src/app/(app)/account/page.tsx:8,43. It is NOT under /settings; that is a placement gap but not an absence. The card exposes in-app + email toggles per event type, and an SMTP-not-configured hint. What is genuinely missing is a dedicated /settings tab for payments (Stripe/Viva/IRIS) — Stripe keys exist only in .env, no UI-managed provider config.

Staff portal PIN gating works: /staff/Yn3pCDWck5BRdvZZYZ4QE9B4wwlo0EE3 + PIN 1926 unlocks staff-leave-card.
Leave form input validation: from>to correctly rejected with toast 'Η ημερομηνία λήξης προηγείται της έναρξης.'
'missing-field' literal is no longer present in invoice_lines (SQLite check returned 0 rows). Line 7 now reads 'Υπηρεσία B2G – παροχή υπηρεσιών Δημοσίου'.

action_items: HIGH: Fix latin() in sepa.ts to transliterate Greek → Latin (mapping table Α→A, Β→V, Γ→G, …) before falling back to 'EMPLOYEE'. Without this every SEPA payroll credit is labelled 'EMPLOYEE'.

HIGH: Add overlap check in createLeaveRequest — reject when a pending/approved leave exists with fromDate ≤ new.toDate AND toDate ≥ new.fromDate (same employee, same org). Also debounce the staff-leave-submit action client-side to prevent the observed double insert.

HIGH: leaveAllowance() must respect emp.endDate. Compute prorated days = (workdays between max(hire, Jan1) and min(end, Dec31)) / (workdays in year) * fullEntitlement. Currently a Jan leaver is credited for the whole year.

HIGH: In decideLeaveRequest, do not auto-submit LIVE ERGANI on approve. Either require an explicit `submitToErgani` flag from the approver UI or force mode=live to generate the file without transmission.

MEDIUM: Add Subject input + data-testids (email-to-input, email-subject-input, email-body-textarea, email-send-btn, email-cancel-btn) to the invoice EmailDialog. Same for staff-leave-* inputs already tagged but leave-reason has no testid.
MEDIUM: Add a dedicated /settings?tab=payments UI so Stripe/Viva/IRIS keys are not env-only.
MEDIUM: Move NotificationPrefsCard into /settings?tab=notifications (or add a link from /settings) so accountants can discover it.
LOW: Replace native input[type=date] with the shadcn Calendar/Popover for consistent Greek localization.
LOW: Scope API_RATE_LIMIT per-endpoint or raise the burst budget.
critical_code_review_comments: sepa.ts:latin() regex is Latin-only and silently produces 'EMPLOYEE' — high-impact for Greek tenants. Add a Greek→Latin map similar to ELOT-743.

leave.ts:createLeaveRequest has no overlap/duplicate guard and the auto-approve path in decideLeaveRequest unconditionally calls submitErgani (LIVE call in production tenants). Two structural risks in one file.
bonuses.ts:leaveDays ignores emp.endDate while daysWithin() in the same file correctly uses it — inconsistent handling of mid-year leavers.
invoice-actions.tsx EmailDialog: no Subject field; recipient rendered as free email input without a preview of the message the recipient sees.
Iteration_29 conflated 'not implemented' with 'placed elsewhere' — NotificationPrefsCard was reported HIGH-missing but is live at /account; the real gap is discoverability from /settings.
Iteration_29 also flagged 'missing-field' in ΤΠ-0007 as a HIGH placeholder leak — verified fixed in current seed DB.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Focus for a retest after fixes: (1) unit-test sepa.ts:latin('Παπαδόπουλος Νίκος') !== 'EMPLOYEE'; (2) createLeaveRequest overlap guard — second identical POST must return 4xx; (3) leaveAllowance for an employee with endDate='2026-01-31' must be ≤ (workdays Jan/annual_workdays)*full; (4) decide-approve on a mode=live org must NOT transmit unless explicit flag. ERGANI org fa82eab8-… is still on LIVE creds — retester should either revert to trial or continue avoiding approvals. Staff token/PIN unchanged.
transport_limitation: External preview /login server-action redirect was intermittent inside the sandboxed Playwright runner (URL stayed on /login after button click, cookie sometimes not persisted between page.goto navigations). Manual curl and staff-portal path (no cookie needed) confirm the deployment is up; iteration_29 already E2E'd the same login. This does not affect the code-level defects reported.
rca_of_the_issue: 1) SEPA 'EMPLOYEE': latin() uses regex [^A-Za-z0-9 …] which drops Greek code points; there is no ELOT-743 transliteration. 2) Duplicate leave: createLeaveRequest inserts unconditionally with no SELECT for overlaps and the client action wrapper does not single-flight. 3) Jan-leaver allowance: leaveDays uses Date.UTC(year,11,31) instead of min(endDate, Dec31). 4) Auto-live ERGANI: decideLeaveRequest treats mode==='live' the same as trial for the LEAVE form.
